description: Configuration schema for running cellranger count on gene expression libraries. This schema defines the required dependencies, references, outputs, and parameters.

deps.description: Input file dependencies required for cellranger count.

captures.description: Path to the captures CSV file.

libraries.description: Path to the libraries CSV file.

fastqs.description: Optional path to the directory containing FASTQ files.

gene-expression.description: Path to the reference transcriptome for gene expression.

outs.description: Output directories for cellranger count results and logs.

results.description: Directory where cellranger count results will be stored.

reports.description: Directory where cellranger reports will be generated.

logs.description: Directory where logs will be stored.

modules.description: Software module versions when using environment modules.

cellranger.description: Version of cellranger module to use.

params.description: Parameters controlling the behavior of cellranger count and (optionally) cellranger aggr.

extras.description: Additional boolean options for enabling or disabling extra processing steps.

predemux.description: If true, predemux cell filtering is enabled.

gene-expression.description: Options specific to cellranger count for gene expression libraries. Boolean values are used to build the CLI option strings.

create-bam.description: If true, a BAM file is created as part of the analysis.

no-secondary.description: If true, secondary alignments are disabled.

include-introns.description: If true, intronic reads are included.

chemistry.description: Specifies the library chemistry. Options are defined by 10X documentation.

check-library-compatibility.description: If true, the workflow checks for library compatibility.

expect-cells.description: Optional. The expected number of cells.

force-cells.description: Optional. The number of cells to force.

min-crispr-umi.description: Optional. The minimum CRISPR UMI count.
